2609.26693.title: Measuring the Serving Stack Instead of the Model: Hidden Confounds in Local Tool-Use Evaluation
2609.26693.paper_summary: A coding agent must emit a valid tool call--a parseable invocation of a tool in the provided schema--before the harness can execute its chosen action. We study how local serving stacks affect this protocol step and show that measured outcomes can depend on the serving layer rather than model behavior alone. In Ollama, the default tools= request is gated per model by a static template flag: some models are accepted and return calls as text, some return native tool_calls, while Phi-3 and Gemma-3 are rejected before inference. In our harness, rejection and retry exhaustion are not preserved as structured failure metadata, so downstream analysis can misclassify them as model non-calls and naively report 0% fidelity. Adding a text tool list while retaining the native channel recovers much of the measured fidelity for accepted models, whereas a uniform text protocol reduces fidelity for Llama-3.2, which has native tool-call support. Cross-stack probes on Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, and SGLang show different handling of the same request. Constrained decoding removes parse failures but can induce non-termination, and turn-pooled versus per-instance estimates differ by up to about 55 points. We conclude with a checklist for treating serving behavior as part of the evaluation protocol.
2609.26693.paper_summary_zh: 一個編碼代理必須發出有效的工具調用——在提供的架構中可解析的工具調用——才能讓工具架構執行其選擇的動作。<lb/>我們研究了本地服務堆棧如何影響這一協議步驟，並顯示測量結果可能依賴於服務層而非僅僅是模型行為。在Ollama中，預設的tools=請求是由靜態模板標誌按模型限制的：某些模型被接受並返回文本調用，某些返回本地tool_calls，而Phi-3和Gemma-3在推理之前被拒絕。在我們的工具架構中，拒絕和重試耗盡不會作為結構化失敗元數據保留，因此下游分析可能會將它們錯誤分類為模型非調用，並天真地報告0%的保真度。<lb/>在保留本地通道的同時添加文本工具列表，為被接受的模型恢復了大部分測量的保真度，而統一文本協議則降低了Llama-3.2的保真度，該模型支持本地工具調用。在Ollama、llama.cpp、vLLM和SGLang上的跨堆棧探測顯示對同一請求的不同處理。<lb/>約束解碼消除了解析失敗，但可能會引起非終止，且轉換池與每實例估計的差異可達約55個點。我們以一個檢查清單作為結論，將服務行為視為評估協議的一部分。
2609.26693.author: Lijuan Tang et.al.
